edges.reason: constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the caller permanently privileged
_mints gates privileged minting on msg.sender == owner or a hardcoded address
init requires msg.sender == owner before writing sale parameters
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before dispersing balances
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before whitelisting an address
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall
transferFrom uses msg.sender for the caller check, allowance read and allowance decrement
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] from caller-controlled input
transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value are performed without SafeMath
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value uses raw unchecked subtraction
approve writes the allowance mapping directly
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] arbitrarily when addedValue > 0
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, granting an ensure whitelist bypass
init writes the minimum sale amount _minSale
init writes the maximum sale amount _maxSale
init writes the per-address sale limit _saleNum
batchSend performs total = _value * _tos.length and balance subtractions/additions unchecked
setTradeAddress writes the whitelisted tradeAddress state
constructor stores the deployer as owner
constructor sets totalSupply from the supply argument
constructor assigns the whole supply to balanceOf[msg.sender]
constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router
constructor reads msg.sender to initialize owner and initial balances
ensure short-circuits to true when canSale[_from] is set
ensure short-circuits to true when _from equals tradeAddress
ensure short-circuits to true when _from or _to equals owner
ensure short-circuits to true when _from equals the UNI router constant
condition reads the per-address sale counter _onSaleNum[_from]
condition reads the _saleNum limit
condition reads the _minSale bound
condition reads the _maxSale bound
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after the transfer
transfer delegates its logic to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value)
transferFrom requires ensure(_from, _to, _value) to pass
ensure requires condition(_from, _value) when no whitelist branch matched
ensure calls pairFor to derive the expected Uniswap pair address
transferFrom executes the unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic block
batchSend executes the unchecked multiplication and balance updates
delegate funnels owner privileges into an arbitrary delegatecall target
delegatecall to an attacker-controlled address can execute arbitrary code and re-enter the token
